title: El Reloj de Zacatlán, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: reloj-zacatlan (MAJESTIC): relojería familiar en Zacatlán de las Manzanas, Puebla. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.MARISOL_TELLEZ: Mexican woman from Puebla, clock repairer, 25 years old, light-brown skin, dark-brown hair in a ponytail, a mustard-yellow cardigan over a white blouse, a brown leather work apron, dark jeans, her hands empty.
chars.ERNESTO_TELLEZ: Mexican man from Puebla, clockmaker, 58 years old, medium build, light-brown skin, short grey hair, a short grey beard, a dark-green wool jacket over a red-and-grey checked flannel shirt, dark trousers, brown boots, his hands empty.
chars.GISELA_RAMOS: Mexican woman, 44 years old, light skin, curly dyed red hair, heavy makeup, long red nails, gold bangles, a tight purple dress, black heels, holding a nail file.

locs.LOC_RELOJERIA: Small family clock shop in Zacatlán de las Manzanas, Puebla, on a foggy morning: walls covered with wooden wall clocks, cuckoo clocks and tall grandfather clocks, a wooden workbench with tiny gears, tweezers and a magnifying lamp, a glass counter with a stool, a window to a foggy cobblestone street, warm lamp light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
